composition.discovery: discover_hierarchical_soft with default SoftDsmConfig (the C1 baseline instrument), occupying the v9 structure stage slot; minimum tail 2000 FE enforced
composition.known_tradeoff: discovery (~96k FE) costs MMES tail time vs v9 (tail ~24k vs ~107k on S3): better structure, worse Phase-I incumbent; whether Phase-II compensates is the G-C question
composition.landscape_probes: v9 verbatim (240 FE, same rng namespaces/partition/probe design)
composition.progress_features: stage mapping identical to v9: probe/warmup/structure(=discovery)/tail
composition.structural_features: v9 formulas and constants (window 174000) over the discovery output
composition.tail: v9 MMES top-up recipe to exactly 180000 FE
composition.warmup: v9 warmup MMES stage mirrored verbatim (60000 FE, same seed namespace; bitwise-identical prefix to v9)

gate.determinism: double-run checkpoint hash equality on every job
gate.landscape_parity: bitwise equality of every probe-derived feature vs the frozen v9 checkpoint of the same (case, seed)
gate.precision: precision==1.0 wherever recovered is non-empty; zero recovered on zero-overlap cases (A1/E1/R1/S1)
gate.recorded_not_gated: shared recall vs C1 frozen range 0.789-1.0; dispatch feature v9/v10 distributions
gate.warmup_parity_recorded: warmup_log10_gain expected bitwise-equal (recorded, included in transfer reference)

seed_rationale: the frozen v9 four-arm matrix seeds - G-B pairs cell-by-cell
